answer.rationale: Activation and onboarding completion are both down 6-4pp QoQ, signaling a core engagement problem rather than pricing pressure on the broader market. Memory_91 shows activation messaging lifted week-one engagement; memory_31 and memory_86 confirm that both signup simplification and onboarding optimization drive activation. Verifying memory_31 and memory_86 ensures those activation-path improvements remain valid before we layer in targeted messaging. Promotional_pricing is rejected because memory_73 shows early retention harm (-12pp) despite acquisition gains; this conflicts with long-term qualified revenue. Referral_incentive worked well (memory_57) but targets existing customers, not the QoQ activation decline. Enterprise_sales_assist (memory_44) is orthogonal to SMB activation drops. Activation_messaging directly addresses the observed metric decline, compounds with proven onboarding improvements, and avoids revenue-quality trade-offs.
